snippet.title: Doki Doki! New Eyes (DDNE) Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The official trailer for the Doki Doki Literature Club fan-game/mod, in which you play through DDLC's original Acts I & 2 with Yuri's Point of View. 

10+ Hours of gameplay, brand new scenes, and a perspective you haven't seen before.

Get it at https://www.cykadev.com/neweyes !

Join our official Discord Server for some fun... and maybe some secrets? https://discord.gg/TDPN4c8
